title: Define Foreign Key Relationship
description: As a database designer, I want to create foreign key relationships between tables so that referential integrity is modeled.
acceptanceCriteria: Given two tables exist on the diagram, when the user creates a relationship from a column in one table to a column in another, then a line (relationship) is drawn between the tables and the foreign key is recorded

evidence: files: src/types/diagram.ts (Relationship type with sourceColumnId/targetColumnId, createRelationship factory, findRelationshipsByTable), src/hooks/useDiagram.ts (addRelationship/removeRelationship recording FK in diagram.relationships), src/components/CreateRelationshipModal.tsx (source table/column -> target table/column selection with validation), src/components/RelationshipLine.tsx (SVG curve line between tables), src/components/DiagramCanvas.tsx (renders RelationshipLine for each diagram.relationships), src/App.tsx (Add Relationship button wired to handleCreateRelationship -> useDiagram.addRelationship)

test-files: src/components/CreateRelationshipModal.test.tsx (12 tests: modal open/close, source/target table and column selects, column selection disabled until table chosen, source table excluded from target options, source columns populated, incomplete selection error, same-table error, onCreate called with column mapping, Create button disabled until complete), src/components/DiagramCanvas.test.tsx (renders relationship lines between tables), src/hooks/useDiagram.test.ts (addRelationship records relationship in model with id, removeTable removes relationships), src/__tests__/diagram-model.test.ts (createRelationship factory with column-to-column mapping, findRelationshipsByTable), src/__tests__/RelationshipLine.test.ts (drawRelationship draws line between tables, returns false when table missing, computes closest edge points)

acceptance-criteria: AC 'Given two tables exist on the diagram, when the user creates a relationship from a column in one table to a column in another, then a line (relationship) is drawn between the tables and the foreign key is recorded' - verified end-to-end via code review: two tables added via CreateTableModal/addTable; CreateRelationshipModal captures source table + source column and target table + target column; App.handleCreateRelationship calls useDiagram.addRelationship storing sourceTableId/sourceColumnId/targetTableId/targetColumnId in diagram.relationships; DiagramCanvas renders a RelationshipLine SVG path between the tables
